note: Carried by Secured.propels (Strands.lean), which sums the alias terms using absorbs and decay_cost (AliasWeights.lean). Differences: the leading power is a general toll L^{-e} rather than ell^{-1}, and the sum runs over the centered aliases of a finite torus with a bound uniform in L, rather than over Z^4.

snippet.text:
lemma propels (h : Secured f) (hj : 4≤j) (e : ℕ) {u : List Axis} (hu : u.length≤j-2)
    (F : ι → Flight j t) (r : ∀ i, Site (F i).L) :
    Pay (fun i => ((((F i).L.val:ℝ)^(e+u.length))⁻¹)) fun i => spread f e u (F i) (r i) := by
  refine ⟨fun i => by positivity, fun a b => ?_⟩
  simp only [spread,Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  let L (i : ι) := (F i).L
  let y (i : ι) := (((L i).val:ℝ)^(e+u.length))⁻¹
  let s (i) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Site (L i)))
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hT⟩ := decay_cost
  apply Moderate.sum_family s (fun i l => y i*decay 2 l) ⟨C,hC,fun i => (by
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum,mul_comm C]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT (L i)) (by unfold y; positivity))⟩
  let I := Σ i, {l // l∈s i}
  let m (i : I) := F i.1
  let q (i : I) := i.2.val
  have he := differential_bound m q e u
  have hp := residue_cost m q (fun i => r i.1)
  have hc := (h.pay.tap a b).index (fun i => ⟨m i,q i⟩)
  apply (hp.mul (he.mul hc)).raise_price
  intro i
  have hn : u.length+2≤j := by omega
  dsimp only
  rw [one_mul,mul_assoc]; apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by positivity)
  apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (decay_anti _ (show 2+u.length≤j by omega)) (pow_nonneg (grade_pos _).le _)).trans (absorbs ..)

proof_context.conclusion: For a difference word u with |u| <= j-2, the alias-summed symbol spread f e u is bounded on the strip, uniformly in the flight, by L^{-(e+|u|)}, by combining the per-alias decay_j bound, the factor L^{-1}grade per difference, absorbs, and the uniform sum of decay 2.

lemma decay_cost : ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ L : Side, (∑ i : Site L, decay 2 i) ≤ C := by
  let C := 1+∑' i, priceAxis i
  have hc (i : ℤ) : 0 ≤ priceAxis i := by unfold priceAxis; positivity
  have hC : 0<C := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (by unfold C; simp only [le_add_iff_nonneg_right]; exact tsum_nonneg hc)
  refine ⟨C^4, pow_pos hC _, fun L => ?_⟩
  have he (l : Site L) : decay 2 l=∏ i, priceAxis (lift l i) := by
    simp [decay,mix,up,priceAxis,Finset.prod_pow]
  have hf (L : Side) : Function.Injective (fun i : ZMod L.val => i.valMinAbs) := fun i j h => by
    simpa using congr_arg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ZMod L.val)) h
  have hb (L : Side) : (∑ i : ZMod L.val, priceAxis i.valMinAbs) ≤ C := calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ univ.image ZMod.valMinAbs, priceAxis x := (Finset.sum_image ((hf L).injOn)).symm
    _ ≤ _ := (priceAxis_sum.sum_le_tsum _ fun i _ => hc i).trans (by unfold C; linarith)
  simp_rw [he]
  unfold lift Site Four
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (κ:= fun _ : Axis => Per L) (fun _ x => priceAxis (ZMod.valMinAbs x))]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∏ _ : Axis, C := Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hc _) (fun _ _ => hb L)
    _ = _ := by simp [Axis]

proof_context.conclusion: The sum over aliases of prod_a (1+|z_a|)^{-2} is bounded uniformly in L.
